engagement: Authorized ethical security assessment of pollinations/pollinations (open-source monorepo). Owner-approved: source review + PoC construction + local execution.
scope_notes: NO live production scanning of pollinations.ai / gen.pollinations.ai / media.pollinations.ai / enter.pollinations.ai is performed.
All PoCs execute against the vendored upstream source locally (unit/integration harness, loopback servers).
No denial-of-service, no bulk resource exhaustion, no credential use against third parties, no live data mutation.
Findings are reported privately as markdown issue files in this repository only; no PR to the upstream public repo.
out_of_scope: Any exploitation of live pollinations infrastructure
Social engineering / phishing of real users
Third-party provider abuse (Stripe, Replicate, fal, E2B, Exa)
